composites.name: US Large Cap Growth Equity
composites.marketingNote: Net of fees, beats the S&P 500 over 1Y, 3Y, and Since-Inception (SI net 17.33% vs S&P 14.87%). Trails the Russell 1000 Growth over 5Y/SI. Strongest 'vs S&P 500' story — the flagship.

composites.name: US Large Cap Value Equity
composites.marketingNote: Net of fees, beats the Russell 1000 Value over 1Y and Since-Inception (SI net 10.67% vs 10.14%). Trails the S&P 500.

composites.name: International ADR Equity
composites.marketingNote: Net of fees, beats MSCI EAFE over 3Y, 5Y, and Since-Inception by a wide margin (SI net 10.33% vs 7.79%). Trails only the 1-year (2025 EAFE rally). Strong international outperformance story.

composites.name: Structured Notes
composites.primaryBenchmark: Custom Blend (40% S&P 500 TR / 30% Bloomberg 1-3M T-Bill / 30% Bloomberg US Agg Bond)
composites.marketingNote: Net of fees, beats its custom blended benchmark over every trailing period (SI net 8.08% vs 7.39%; 3Y net 18.85% vs 11.92%). Note: benchmark is a custom blend, not a single index.

composites.name: Index Advantage Global ETF
composites.marketingNote: Tactical / fully diversified ETF sleeve. Trails MSCI ACWI across periods — do NOT frame as 'beating the market'; frame as diversified, lower-cost core exposure.

composites.name: Index Advantage International ETF
composites.marketingNote: Tactical ETF sleeve. Trails MSCI EAFE — frame as diversified ex-US exposure, not outperformance.

composites.name: Index Advantage Small/Mid ETF
composites.marketingNote: Tactical ETF sleeve. Trails Russell 2500. No 5Y (inception Feb 2021).

composites.name: REIT Equity
composites.marketingNote: Trails its REIT benchmark; modest/negative net SI. Do not feature for performance.
